summary: Qogita is wholesale Powered By Technology, founded in 2021. Type: startup / scale-up. About 174 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

culture.text: Founded in 2021, about 170 staff from 66 nationalities, working from hubs in Amsterdam and London.
Staff often studied economics, international business or computer science at UvA, VU, Erasmus or Groningen.
It describes a small team where everyone is accountable for successes and failures.

open.text: Qogita EU B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.

growth.text: It says it made 85 hires across Europe and the UK in the past 6 months.
It is backed by Accel, Bessemer, Dawn and LocalGlobe and operates in 30+ European markets.
